input.summary: Add Customer 30-day convenience termination with pro-rata refund; limit Kubient convenience right to end of Term
input.comment: [Playbook] We have added our right to terminate for convenience on thirty (30) days' notice with a refund of prepaid fees and no early-termination penalty, and limited Kubient's convenience right so it cannot exit mid-term. Our position is that the customer can exit on notice without penalty while the vendor is committed for the term; if helpful, we can move to 60 days' notice for our termination and keep Kubient's 90-day notice at the end of a Term.

ops.oldText: Neither Party may terminate this Agreement during the Initial Term except as set forth in paragraph 4(b) or any Exhibit. Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party. Except for termination for material breach as detailed in paragraph 4(b), Kubient shall be entitled to all fees generated during the termination period regardless of which Party terminates the Agreement,
ops.newText: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Exhibit for convenience, in whole or in part, at any time (including during the Initial Term) upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Kubient, in which case Kubient shall refund to Customer any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination and no early termination fee or penalty shall apply. Kubient may not terminate this Agreement for convenience during the Initial Term or any renewal term, but may terminate this Agreement effective at the end of the then-current Term upon ninety (90) days' prior written notice to Customer. Except for termination for material breach as detailed in paragraph 4(b), Kubient shall be entitled to fees generated only through the effective date of termination,
